name: itqan/flarum-llms
description: LLM-readable Markdown exports of discussions and a spec-compliant /llms.txt index for the Itqan community

suggest.flarum/tags: Groups the /llms.txt index by tag instead of listing one flat block of recent discussions
suggest.itqan/flarum-discussions: Adds the vote score and the threaded-reply tree to the Markdown export
suggest.fof/discussion-language: Records each discussion's language so the index can group by it
